text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run the tests: I don't have a shell in this session, so I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I checked each fix by reading it against its test, and I expect the whole suite to pass. Please run it to confirm.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`, which also stopped the search test file from loading at all.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` kept the year as a string, so `age()` failed. It now converts the year to an integer.
- **`factory.py`**: added the missing third sample book, `Emma` (Austen, 1815). The docstring says it should be there.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying. 4 days now gives 1.00, not 4.25.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns exactly the last `n`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3, but the comment and tests say 5. I changed it to 5.

I didn't change any tests.
